title.narrative: ​​Priority #1 - Support to underserved IDPs and host communities, including returnees in contested areas​

description.narrative: This project aims to alleviate protection risks and threats as well as addressing protection gaps identified through assessments and community engagement. In response to the situation, the intervention will provide critical life-saving protection services and assistance to internally displaced people, returnees, and affected members of the host community in underfunded IDP emergencies. The response will directly benefit populations in Afar region, where over 77,000 people have been displaced due to the historic Afar-Isa conflict, which reignited in April 2024 and in Amhara and Tigray regions, where the November 2020 to November 2022 Tigray conflict left more than 950,000 people displaced. In collaboration with partners and government counterparts, UNHCR will directly target about 49,704 individuals in the contested areas of Amhara (Mai Tsebri and Adi Arkai), Tigray (Southern and Northern Tigray), and Afar. Through undertaking protection monitoring that will involve protection assessment to identify needs and risks, promotion and enhancing rights on housing, land and property (HLP) and provision of unconditional multi-purpose cash assistance to address identified needs, the results will be an enhancement of the protection of the rights of the conflict-impacted populations, particularly women and children, who have been rendered extremely vulnerable to rights violations, including exploitation and abuse. Rights to property, particularly on land and housing, have been severely violated due to the conflict situation characterized by displacement insecurity exacerbated by the conflict. Through the project’s interventions, the protection of targeted populations will be enhanced, their rights to housing land and property secured and the unconditional cash assistance would enable them to address some of the immediate protection and humanitarian needs hence also reducing their vulnerability and exposure to risk of rights violation.
